comparison_scope.purpose: Compare PR97 and PR100 before deciding whether to run a third one-case pilot, pause, simplify, or broaden.
comparison_scope.evidence_limit: Two Codex-assisted one-case pilots are enough to make a gate decision, not enough to prove product value or contract reliability.

compared_pilots.strongest_useful_signal: Local-private specialist reads made authority transfer, transition boundaries, stop conditions, and relationship-cost tension more concrete than the sparse Decision Trail shell.
compared_pilots.strongest_limit: The pre-PR99 shape did not make vanilla overlap, lost-value severity, assistant-influence source status, truncation impact, or fan-in downgrade triggers first-class enough.
compared_pilots.broadening_implication: Do not broaden from PR97 directly; patch contracts first.

compared_pilots.strongest_useful_signal: The PR99 fields forced a downgrade because vanilla_overlap_read was material_overlap_candidate.
compared_pilots.strongest_limit: The post-PR99 shape has only been exercised on one additional case, with no human validation and no diverse failure case.
compared_pilots.broadening_implication: Do not broaden yet; run at most one diversity-targeted third one-case pilot.

comparison_findings.read: Both pilots suggest local-private packet access can make conversation shape, likely action, friction, and fan-in more concrete than sparse checked-in-safe reports.
comparison_findings.limit: This remains Codex-assisted and unvalidated; it does not prove the reads are right.

comparison_findings.read: PR100 is less positive than PR97 in a useful way because vanilla overlap became explicit and fan-in preserved the downgrade.
comparison_findings.limit: One post-patch case is not enough to treat the patched contract as stable.

comparison_findings.read: PR100 shows that likely-action comparison must ask what was already present in the vanilla conversation before crediting Lolla with a delta.
comparison_findings.limit: Vanilla overlap still depends on messy interpretation and cannot be deterministically inferred from raw prose.

comparison_findings.read: Both pilots surface lost value, but neither can calibrate severity without human or stronger contextual review.
comparison_findings.limit: Lost-value fields should stay candidate-only and source-limited.

comparison_findings.read: The two pilots justify a comparison gate and possibly one contrastive third pilot, not a broad specialist-output batch.
comparison_findings.limit: There is still no real no-change, noisy, worse, or clearly inconclusive local-private specialist-output case.

gate_decision.recommended_next_slice: PR102 Decision Trail Third One-Case Diversity Pilot v0
decision_rationale: PR97 showed specialist-output usefulness but exposed contract gaps.
PR100 showed the patch can make a read more conservative through material vanilla overlap.
The evidence is still only two one-case pilots and does not include a diverse failure shape.
stop_or_simplify_conditions: If no safe completed run from a different decision family exists, pause instead of forcing PR102.
If PR102 only adds another positive or partial read without exposing a new failure shape, stop and prepare human-review intake or simplify.
If PR102 reveals that the contracts are too heavy for review, simplify before any further pilot.
If local-private packet review cannot be kept out of checked-in artifacts, stop the lane.

pr102_recommendation.recommended_slice: PR102 Decision Trail Third One-Case Diversity Pilot v0
pr102_recommendation.purpose: Run at most one more local-private specialist-output pilot using the PR99/PR100 shape on a different decision family.
pr102_recommendation.selection_rule: Pre-register why the selected run is a contrast to PR97 and PR100 before reading local-private packet content.

non_claims: PR101 is not an automatic label.
PR101 is not agent action authorization.
PR101 does not show that either revised answer was good advice.
what_would_change_this_decision: A human reviewer may decide the pilots are too thin or too cumbersome and pause the lane.
A future third pilot may show that the patched fields are still too positive or too heavy.
A future third pilot may reveal a no-change, noisy, worse, or inconclusive case and force another contract patch.
A lack of safe local-private access to a diverse completed run should stop PR102 rather than produce artificial evidence.
